primitives.name: Feed Integrity Validation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Today's selection is therefore built the way prior corrected runs were: **4 verified posts from attempt 2 + the 2 newest posts of feed creator @simplifyinai fetched via cli + 14 posts from the Oct 31 PM feed's inventoried-only backlog** (positions 27–85, genuine inventory, never dissected).
primitives.assumptions: All posts must be validated via CLI before inclusion; no ad or duplicate entries allowed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when attempt 1 returns fabricated shortcodes or attempt 2 fails to resolve valid shortcodes.

layer2.mapping: GSI's validation logic mirrors GSE's feed ingestion state machine, where each post is a transition event confirmed by CLI resolution.
layer2.telemetry: Number of new posts vs. duplicates in selection.

primitives.name: Read-Only CLI Ingestion
primitives.verbatim_quote: Read-only throughout; browser transparency: attempt 1's tab briefly opened the DM inbox URL (~3s, no messages read or sent, per its report) and attempt 2 dismissed a hover save-picker with Escape; nothing was liked, saved, followed, commented, or messaged by this run's own cli work.
primitives.assumptions: CLI actions must be strictly read-only; no user interaction with UI elements during ingestion.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs if any CLI action modifies state beyond read access.

layer2.mapping: GSE's ingestion kernel is derived from GSI's read-only telemetry, ensuring no behavioral bias in data capture.
layer2.telemetry: CLI action log showing zero write events.

primitives.name: Memory-Layered Retrieval
primitives.verbatim_quote: Garrett's fleet memory today is file-based (MEMORY.md + daily logs + memory search); this is that same doctrine as a product, with an MCP surface his bus already speaks.
primitives.assumptions: Memory retrieval is layered: curated judgments atop raw logs; search is scoped to local memory.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs if raw logs are not indexed or curated layer is bypassed.

layer2.mapping: GSE's memory system is derived from GSI's curated judgment layer, with MemPalace providing the raw log layer beneath.
layer2.telemetry: Search latency and recall accuracy across curated vs. raw memory layers.

This is modeled as a binary classification problem over post validity, where each post is scored based on CLI resolution and seen-index cross-reference. The read-only CLI ingestion primitive enforces a deterministic, non-behavioral data capture process, preventing contamination from user interaction. Memory-layered retrieval introduces a dual-state architecture: a curated judgment layer and a raw log layer, enabling both high-level reasoning and low-level recall. These primitives form a closed-loop system where validation feeds into memory, which then informs future ingestion decisions. Failure modes include CLI misbehavior, memory indexing errors, or validation bypasses.
